oe_feu_dec_france_royal_domain = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_feu_is_france_host = yes
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_feu_mod_dec_france_royal_domain }
	}
	allow = {
		gold >= 120
		stability >= 0
		num_subjects >= 3
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { gold >= 220 num_subjects >= 5 } add = 25 }
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_feu_dec_france_royal_domain.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_feu_dec_france_royal_domain_tt
			add_gold = -120
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
			add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
			every_subject = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_mild_minus
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_feu_mod_sub_france_oath years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_feu_mod_france_hyw_oath years = 10 mode = replace }
				every_subject = {
					limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
					add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_minus
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_feu_mod_dec_france_royal_domain years = 20 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_feu_ev_1_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_feu_ev_1_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_feu.1
			}
		}
	}
}
